name: ir_id
meaning: <dataset>-<16 hex>: the dataset id and the first 16 hex digits of the BLAKE2b hash of file#item (of file alone when item is empty). Unique, and recomputed from file and item by a check

name: dataset
meaning: The dataset id (also its folder name in registry/)

name: space
meaning: <dataset>/<slug>: the room, hall, car or simulated room

name: condition
empty_means: the dataset has one state of the space
meaning: The state of the space during the measurement, as the dataset names it: a panel setting, a furniture layout, a door open or closed

name: source
empty_means: the dataset does not name source positions
meaning: The source position, as the dataset names it

name: receiver
empty_means: the dataset does not name receiver positions
meaning: The receiver position, as the dataset names it

name: is_primary
meaning: True for the one layout per space that counts in statistics. A selection without --format takes primary rows only

name: duplicate_of
empty_means: no other IR in the table has the same audio_hash
meaning: The ir_id of the original of an exact duplicate: the IR from the earliest dataset by year, then the smallest id

name: file
meaning: The path inside the dataset's files. Two paths joined by | when a response spans two files

name: item
meaning: The position of the IR inside the file (an index or a key, as the reader names it)

name: download
meaning: The download that holds the file (a key of downloads.parquet)

name: audio_hash
meaning: First 32 hex digits of a hash of the decoded samples (float32, channel after channel): in 0.9 the SHA-1 of the samples, from analyser v1; from 1.0 the SHA-256 of the sample rate, the channel count and the samples. get checks every IR it cuts against it

name: fs
meaning: Sample rate of the file

name: channels
meaning: Number of channels in this response

name: duration_s
meaning: Length of the response as published

name: sample_format
meaning: How the samples are stored in the file

name: measured_on
meaning: The channels the room values describe: L+R (mean of two ears or a stereo pair), W (Ambisonic omni), ch0 (one reference capsule or the mono channel)

name: origin
meaning: How the IR came to exist. The dataset's origin, unless its space states its own

name: format
meaning: The channel format of the response

name: layout
meaning: The capture format: which device or arrangement recorded the channels

name: space_type
empty_means: never empty (unknown when the dataset does not say)
meaning: The kind of space. The space's own type in spaces.csv; otherwise the dataset's default

name: volume_m3
empty_means: the dataset does not state the volume
meaning: Volume of the space, as the dataset or its paper states it

name: distance_m
meaning: Source-receiver distance

name: src_x
empty_means: the dataset gives no source position
meaning: Source x, in the dataset's own frame

name: src_y
empty_means: the dataset gives no source position
meaning: Source y, in the dataset's own frame

name: src_z
empty_means: the dataset gives no source position
meaning: Source z, in the dataset's own frame

name: rcv_x
empty_means: the dataset gives no receiver position
meaning: Receiver x, in the dataset's own frame

name: rcv_y
empty_means: the dataset gives no receiver position
meaning: Receiver y, in the dataset's own frame

name: rcv_z
empty_means: the dataset gives no receiver position
meaning: Receiver z, in the dataset's own frame

name: licence
empty_means: never empty (LicenseRef-unspecified when no licence was found)
meaning: The licence id (SPDX where one exists): the space's licence, else the dataset's. Must have a row in licences.csv

name: licence_conditions
meaning: The licence's conditions joined by +, from: attribution, share_alike, non_commercial, no_derivatives

name: use_research
meaning: May the audio be used in research? Read from licences.csv

name: use_commercial
meaning: May the audio be used in a commercial product or service? Read from licences.csv

name: use_training
meaning: May the audio be used to train a machine-learning model? Read from licences.csv

name: redistribute
meaning: May the audio be passed on to others? Read from licences.csv

name: is_processed
meaning: True when any proc_* column is documented, detected or both. False means no tag was found among those assessed

name: proc_windowed
meaning: Faded at the end. 0.9: documented by the authors only

name: proc_truncated
empty_means: not assessed (no broadband noise floor was found)
meaning: Cut before the noise floor without a fade (processing.truncated)

name: proc_denoised
meaning: Noise removed or the tail replaced. Documented by the authors only (deferred.md item 5)

name: proc_equalised
meaning: Corrected for the loudspeaker or microphone. Documented by the authors only (deferred.md item 5)

name: proc_resampled
meaning: The content stops at another rate's Nyquist (processing.resampled). Detected counts as a minor defect

name: proc_bit_depth_reduced
empty_means: not assessed (0.9: analyser v1 does not measure the effective bit depth)
meaning: Fewer bits used than the container holds. Detected counts as a minor defect

name: proc_format_derived
meaning: Converted from another layout, e.g. binaural decoded from Ambisonics. Documented by the authors only

name: grade
empty_means: the space is anechoic: there is no decay to grade
meaning: Quality of the decay, capped by defects (grades in thresholds.yaml). --grade A means A or better

name: defects_major
meaning: Number of true major defect columns

name: defects_minor
meaning: Number of true minor defect columns, plus proc_resampled and proc_bit_depth_reduced when detected

name: defect_clipping
meaning: Major. Samples held at the peak level (defects.clipping)

name: defect_dropouts
meaning: Major. A run of exact zeros inside the signal (defects.dropouts)

name: defect_no_decay
meaning: Major. The level does not fall: T60 above 30 s, or not an IR (defects.no_decay)

name: defect_sweep_residue
meaning: Major. A sweep or chirp left in the response (defects.sweep_residue)

name: defect_tonal_interference
meaning: Major. Sustained spectral lines: hum, tones, birdsong (defects.tonal_interference)

name: defect_corrupt_samples
meaning: Major. Non-finite or all-zero samples, or a file that cannot be read

name: defect_band_limited
meaning: Minor. Little or no content in the upper audible band (defects.band_limited)

name: defect_quantisation_floor
meaning: Minor. The decay sinks below the quantisation step (defects.quantisation_floor)

name: defect_dc_offset
meaning: Minor. A constant offset in a channel (defects.dc_offset)

name: defect_high_noise_floor
meaning: Minor. peak_to_noise_db below defects.high_noise_floor (a decay into exact digital silence has no noise floor, so no defect)

name: defect_inverted_channel
empty_means: the format is not stereo or binaural, or not assessed (0.9: analyser v1 does not measure it)
meaning: Minor. Two channels of one IR with opposite polarity. Never applied to Ambisonic signals

name: usable_top_hz
empty_means: not measured (0.9: analyser v1 does not measure it)
meaning: Upper edge of the highest third-octave band whose early level rises at least 20 dB above both its tail noise and its quantisation floor

name: effective_bits
empty_means: not measured (0.9: analyser v1 does not measure it)
meaning: The bit depth the samples really use: 16-bit content in a 24-bit or float file shows as 16

name: peak_to_noise_db
empty_means: no noise floor: the decay runs into exact digital silence
meaning: Peak level over the broadband noise floor

name: edt_mid
empty_means: EDT not valid in the 500 Hz or 1 kHz octave (validity.edt); see decay_range_mid_db
meaning: Early decay time: mean of the 500 Hz and 1 kHz octaves

name: t20_mid
empty_means: T20 not valid in the 500 Hz or 1 kHz octave (validity.t20); see decay_range_mid_db
meaning: T20: mean of the 500 Hz and 1 kHz octaves

name: t30_mid
empty_means: T30 not valid in the 500 Hz or 1 kHz octave (validity.t30); see decay_range_mid_db
meaning: T30: mean of the 500 Hz and 1 kHz octaves

name: rt_mid
empty_means: neither T30 nor T20 is valid in both mid octaves
meaning: The reverberation time: t30_mid where valid, otherwise t20_mid. Used by --balance t30 and the examples

name: rt_mid_from
meaning: Which decay time rt_mid is

name: decay_range_mid_db
empty_means: the decay reaches exact digital silence in a mid octave (no noise floor), or the decay analysis failed
meaning: The smaller of the 500 Hz and 1 kHz decay ranges (peak level over the noise floor): says why a mid value is empty

name: rt_broadband
empty_means: neither T30 nor T20 of the broadband signal is valid
meaning: The same rule as rt_mid, measured on the whole signal (limited to the analysed range: 63 Hz to 8 kHz in analyser v1). Equals the broadband row of bands

name: rt_broadband_from
meaning: Which decay time rt_broadband is

name: decay_range_broadband_db
empty_means: the decay reaches exact digital silence (no noise floor), or the decay analysis failed
meaning: Decay range of the broadband signal

name: c50_mid
empty_means: not valid in the 500 Hz or 1 kHz octave (validity.energy)
meaning: Clarity C50: mean of the 500 Hz and 1 kHz octaves

name: c80_mid
empty_means: not valid in the 500 Hz or 1 kHz octave (validity.energy)
meaning: Clarity C80: mean of the 500 Hz and 1 kHz octaves

name: d50_mid
empty_means: not valid in the 500 Hz or 1 kHz octave (validity.energy)
meaning: Definition D50: mean of the 500 Hz and 1 kHz octaves

name: ts_mid
empty_means: not valid in the 500 Hz or 1 kHz octave (validity.energy)
meaning: Centre time: mean of the 500 Hz and 1 kHz octaves

name: drr_db
empty_means: no direct sound could be found
meaning: Direct-to-reverberant ratio: full band, direct sound within +-8 ms of its peak, noise subtracted (ACE convention)

name: sti
empty_means: not valid (validity.sti): the sample rate is too low, or the broadband decay failed, is truncated or too short
meaning: Speech transmission index (IEC 60268-16:2020 indirect method; room only)

name: iacc_early
meaning: Early interaural cross-correlation IACC_E3: 0 to 80 ms, lags up to 1 ms, mean of the 500 Hz, 1 kHz and 2 kHz octaves

name: lateral_fraction
applies_when: format is ambisonic and the orientation is documented
empty_means: not Ambisonic, the orientation is not documented, or not measured (0.9: v1 measured it on first-order Ambisonics only)
meaning: Early lateral fraction from the W and Y channels

name: bass_ratio
empty_means: a needed octave has no valid T30 or T20
meaning: Bass ratio: (T125 + T250) / (T500 + T1000), each band T30 where valid, else T20

name: treble_ratio
empty_means: a needed octave has no valid T30 or T20
meaning: Treble ratio: (T2000 + T4000) / (T500 + T1000), each band T30 where valid, else T20

name: mixing_time_ms
meaning: Mixing time: where the normalised echo density first reaches 1 (Abel and Huang 2006)

name: t30_31
empty_means: not valid (validity.t30), or the band is not measured (0.9: analyser v1 has no 31.5 Hz octave)
meaning: T30 in the 31.5 Hz octave. Equals the octave row of bands

name: t30_63
meaning: T30 in the 63 Hz octave. Equals the octave row of bands

name: t30_125
meaning: T30 in the 125 Hz octave. Equals the octave row of bands

name: t30_250
meaning: T30 in the 250 Hz octave. Equals the octave row of bands

name: t30_500
meaning: T30 in the 500 Hz octave. Equals the octave row of bands

name: t30_1000
meaning: T30 in the 1 kHz octave. Equals the octave row of bands

name: t30_2000
meaning: T30 in the 2 kHz octave. Equals the octave row of bands

name: t30_4000
meaning: T30 in the 4 kHz octave. Equals the octave row of bands

name: t30_8000
empty_means: not valid (validity.t30), or the band lies above 0.9 x Nyquist
meaning: T30 in the 8 kHz octave. Equals the octave row of bands

name: t30_16000
empty_means: not valid (validity.t30), the band lies above 0.9 x Nyquist, or not measured (0.9: analyser v1 has no 16 kHz octave)
meaning: T30 in the 16 kHz octave. Equals the octave row of bands

name: ir_id
meaning: The IR (a key of irs)

name: series
meaning: Which band series the row belongs to. Every query names it: both series have a 125 Hz band

name: band_hz
empty_means: the row is the broadband row
meaning: Nominal centre frequency of the band

name: edt
meaning: Early decay time

name: c50
meaning: Clarity C50

name: c80
meaning: Clarity C80

name: d50
meaning: Definition D50

name: ts
meaning: Centre time

name: decay_range_db
empty_means: the decay reaches exact digital silence (no noise floor), or the decay analysis failed
meaning: Smoothed peak level over the noise floor: says why a decay value is empty. Values of hundreds of dB mean a floor near digital silence (float files)

name: floor
empty_means: not measured (0.9: analyser v1 does not classify the floor)
meaning: What ends the decay: real noise, the quantisation step, exact zeros, or nothing (the decay runs to the end)

name: iacc_early
applies_when: series is octave and format is binaural
empty_means: not binaural or not an octave row
meaning: Early interaural cross-correlation in this band: 0 to 80 ms, lags up to 1 ms

name: lateral_fraction
applies_when: series is octave and format is ambisonic with a documented orientation
empty_means: not Ambisonic, orientation not documented, or not an octave row
meaning: Early lateral fraction in this band
